id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Ho ho ho. I've been waiting for you to come.
"I don't see that lady who was with you. Just the old man by yourself?
"For certain reasons, I've asked the princess to step away. But you've come a long way, haven't you.
"Well, you told us to come, so we did. Give back the Rainbough you stole. We need that branch.
"...I thought you died sixteen years ago. When I saw the mark on your hand in Octagonia, my heart nearly stopped.
"There is something I simply must show {var:1}. Humor this old man for a little while.
